content:
Marta: Quick heads-up — our new engineering manager (platform) starts Mon. I want a compact preboard + first-week plan that accounts for hybrid (office+remote). Also who owns desk booking and local SIM for travel days?

Devon: @Marta I can handle desk booking (we use OfficeHub). Send me the office days and Ill reserve a hot desk + locker. For SIM, @Omar handles vendor logistics.

Omar: Yup. For international folks we order an eSIM and a local SIM fallback. Need passport + local address. Ill DM Marta the procurement form.

Jia: Putting a small manager-focused preboard checklist here (short):
- Preboard (Day -3 to Day 0): confirm laptop model + accessories, Okta invite sent, GitHub invite, calendar onboard slot, office desk reserved if hybrid
- Day 0: manager signs AUP/NDAs (send via DocuSign) + confirm payroll forms submitted
- Day 1 AM: People Ops welcome (benefits, org chart), IT verify device & VPN
- Day 1 PM: Manager 1:1 (30m): role priorities, org expectations, immediate 30/60 goals
- Day 2: Buddy pairing for dev env + tiny onboarding task (CI run)
- Day 3: Cross-team intros (SRE, Security, Product) 20m each
- End week 1: 30m sync on blockers & 60-day plan draft

Jia: Who to ping on common blocks: 
- Okta/G-suite issues: people-ops IT (it-support@redwood.internal) or ping me
- GitHub org/repo access: @Devon (eng-admin) or #eng-plat
- VPN/KMS access: @Omar or #security-ops

Marta: Love it. Can you paste a lightweight first-week agenda thats not meeting-heavy? Prefer one in-email copyable format.

Jia: Sure, short agenda below — designed for hybrid folks (works if fully remote too):

Mon (onsite or remote)
- 09:30 AM  Welcome & people ops essentials (30m)
- 10:15 AM  IT checklist & device handoff (20m)
- 11:00 AM  Manager 1:1: expectations + immediate priorities (30m)
- 12:30 PM  Team lunch (30m)
- 02:00 PM  Calm hour: calendar-free time to read docs + setup

Tue
- 09:30 AM  Pair: dev env + run onboarding CI (2h)
- 02:00 PM  Product intro w/PM (30m)

Wed
- 10:00 AM  Security & compliance primer (Omar) (45m)
- 03:00 PM  SRE handoff: deploy flow + runbooks (30m)

Thu
- Focus: first small deliverable (bug/infra tweak) + team 1:1s

Fri
- 11:00 AM  Week 1 retro + agree next 60-day priorities (30m)

Marta: Nice. The calm hour is great. Keeps cognitive load down.

Devon: For the onboarding task I recommend: clone repo, run `./scripts/bootstrap.sh`, open a tiny PR to fix a README typo — validates permissions + CI. Ill be buddy.

Omar: Security preboard note: if they need staging KMS keys, we require manager approval + scoped role. I can pre-create a short-lived role for early dev, rotate keys after first month.

HR Bot: New-hire packet created: "Eng Manager - Platform  start 2026-04-06". Tasks assigned: Marta (manager), Devon (eng-admin buddy), Omar (security contact), Jia (people-ops). Preboard emails scheduled. Link: https://hr.redwood.internal/onboard/ENG-772

Marta: Thanks everyone. Ill share this with the candidate and book the first-week slots. Devon  please reserve a desk for Wed + Thu. Omar  Ill send the signed AUP tonight.

Devon: On it. Desk reserved: Tower B, Hot-Desk 12 (Wed/Thu). Il also add the buddy pairing to their calendar.

Omar: Got the AUP note. Once approved Il prepare the security invite and the scoped staging role.

Jia: Loop closed on my side. Il pop the agenda into a short welcome email template and drop in #cal-templates.

Marta: Closing — thanks all. This is exactly the concise plan I needed. :raised_hands:
